title: Hardmode treasure bags, trophies and missing Expert items (Demon Heart slot, Minecart Upgrade Kit pieces)
player_outcome: Every hardmode boss drops its Treasure Bag in Expert, and every boss can drop a trophy. The Wall of Flesh's Demon Heart opens a sixth accessory slot in Expert worlds. The mechanical bosses' three Mechanical pieces combine into a Minecart Upgrade Kit.
design: Treasure bags for queen_slime, the_twins (dropped by the last twin; the loot table 'the_twins' already shared), the_destroyer, skeletron_prime, plantera, golem, duke_fishron, empress_of_light and moon_lord. The Lunatic Cultist has no bag, as in Terraria.
Trophies for the same bosses; same patterns as P4-04.
Restructure the hardmode boss tables into data/loot/bosses.json.
Expert items in the bags: volatile_gelatin, spore_sac, shiny_stone, shrimpy_truffle (existing), plus the new demon_heart and mechanical pieces.
demon_heart: consume behavior. New ConsumeParams.ExtraAccessorySlot sets PlayerState.ExtraAccessorySlot = true (saved).

PlayerInventory.AccessorySlots becomes 6 with the 6th usable only when the flag is set and the world is Expert or Master (PlayerInventory.ActiveAccessorySlots(bool expertWorld)). The equip logic and EffectState only read active slots.
game/UI/InventoryScreen.cs draws the 6th slot when active.

mechanical_wheel_piece (Twins), mechanical_battery_piece (Destroyer), mechanical_cart_piece (Prime; Terraria's 'Mechanical Wagon Piece' if the reference names it so) combine by recipe into minecart_upgrade_kit (at a tinkerers_workshop).
minecart_upgrade_kit: consume sets PlayerState.MinecartUpgrade. Gameplay/Mounts/MinecartRide speed × 1.25 and contact damage 30 to creatures hit while riding fast.
Deferred and documented: gravity_globe and suspicious_looking_tentacle (need the gravity-flip and pet systems), Deerclops' Bone Helm.
Models: trophies and bags via trophies.py; pieces via gear or clockwork generators.
files_modify: data/items/equipment.json or new data/items/expert_items.json — demon_heart, pieces, kit
src/Strata.Core/Gameplay/Player (PlayerState and its persistence model) — flags saved
files_add: data/items/expert_items.json — Demon Heart, mechanical pieces, Minecart Upgrade Kit
data_changes: 9 bags, 9 trophies, 5 new items, 1 recipe; hardmode boss tables restructured.
risks: The accessory-slot count overlaps the UI phase's equipment rework (hook/mount/pet/vanity/dye slots). Sequence after it or keep the change minimal.
Player save format changes need a PlayerState version bump or a tolerant default.
